breaks.quote: he came to me with a deadline: the December meeting, in his own voice.
breaks.why: The deadline is named but nothing shows what Aiman stands to lose if he misses it, so the beat has no stakes and the reader has no reason to care.

breaks.quote: He tried out his opening line on his morning customers.
breaks.why: A weak beat is filled with an extra scene instead of a concrete risk, so the story moves but nothing is on the line.
